Method of Attack: Malware that makes ATMs dispense cash by connecting to the ATM's USB port and running the malware
Cutlet Maker app interacts with ATM software APIs to dispense cash
Stimulator app queries ATM cash cassette balances
c0decalc file worked as a license generator for the main app in older version
Attack Vector: Physical access to ATM USB port, connecting USB hub with wireless keyboard, mouse, and Flash storage device containing malware
